stable.notes: The meeting write-up, with two copy buttons: a compact form for pasting into a message and a full form with the speaker-labelled transcript. Per-voice talk time and share of identified speech, hidden below 60% identified because a share of a small identified slice reads more precise than it is. Names say how they were established: by wearing the device, by voice match, or because you named that voice. Personal meetings are marked before the content. And when you remove a voice from a meeting, the panel now says so above the write-up, because the write-up was generated earlier and may still use the name. Needs glasses-server 6.21.30; older servers omit the newer fields rather than showing zeros.
